name: DR Congo (east)
value: OCHA: 323,000 displaced; FRN on UN sanctions
summary: OCHA counts 323,000 displaced in South Kivu 6–9 Nov; UN adds FRN to sanctions list 12 Nov; no major city has fallen
state: OCHA reported on 11 Nov that FRN–army fighting in Kalehe and Kabare, South Kivu, displaced over 323,000 people between 6 and 9 Nov and killed at least five civilians around Bunyakiri (Actualite.cd, 12 Nov). The army said more than ten civilians were killed in Kalehe between 7 and 12 Nov, and Radio Okapi described a precarious calm in Bulambika and Bunyakiri centre on 13 Nov. On 12 Nov the UN added the FRN to the Alliance Fleuve Congo entry on its sanctions list (Actualite.cd). No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira and no direct interstate fighting was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Kalehe, Kabare and Walikale face displacement and disrupted aid. FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Aid access and the Ebola response in the east are affected by the fighting.
rubric_hit: Active fighting (Watch); no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting (Alert line)
